title: command_bump_budget
description: Schema for bump_budget command-JSON files written to $STATE_DIR/commands/ by the operator. Polled between iterations by orchestrator.sh main loop via lib/command_dispatch.sh (FUP-0815). Effect: writes $STATE_DIR/budget_override.json which run_claude_json reads on its next pre-call check, using max($BUDGET_CAP, $override) as the effective cap. Runtime control, not a Phase-Z cost gate. additionalProperties:true mirrors the FUP-0734 / FUP-0749 precedent on gate_request.schema.json.

command_type.description: Discriminator. MUST be the literal string 'bump_budget'.

command_id.description: Stable identifier for this command instance. Convention: bump_budget_<iso8601_utc>.

issued_by.description: Identifier of the caller. Convention: 'operator-cc-scribe' for scribe-originated.

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of command issuance.

new_cap_usd.description: Requested new budget cap in USD. Effective cap is max(seed.budget.tokens_usd, $new_cap_usd) — bumps NEVER reduce the seed-declared cap below its original value.

reason.description: Optional free-form rationale for the budget bump (informational; not consumed by dispatch logic).
